scope_note: DET01-specific direct-evidence follow-up. The operator data sheet supplies current facility-area and rated-power observations at 21005 Lahser Road. The 2014 operator release bounds the initial launch chronology but supplies no quantitative construction, supplier, payroll, community-funding, resource-use or public-cost observation. The values below are source-reported specifications, not audited utilization, expenditure or impact measures.

sources.title: Detroit DET01 data sheet
sources.notes: The current operator sheet identifies DET01 at 21005 Lahser Road, Building 4, reports a 39,900-square-foot facility and 3 MW of N+1 power, and separately describes a potential second 7 MW building. Only the existing DET01 specifications are transcribed; the potential second building is not treated as operating capacity. The sheet describes N+1 CRAC cooling but provides no metered electricity, PUE, WUE, water, wastewater, generator runtime or emissions value.

project_updates.notes: The operator reports 39,900 square feet and 3 MW N+1 for the existing DET01 facility. A potential 7 MW second building remains a separate forward-looking descriptor. project_updates.project_description: EdgeConneX DET01 is a 39,900-square-foot colocation data center in Southfield, Michigan, created by remodeling a vacant commercial shell in 2014 and documented as operating by March 11, 2015. The account separates the original conversion from a potential second building and follows the existing facility's real property, industrial-facilities-tax period, post-expiration personal property, and rated power.

project_updates.title: Initial launch chronology remains bounded rather than treated as an exact commissioning date
project_updates.notes: The July 2014 operator release projected a November 2014 launch; the pre-existing evidence establishes operation no later than March 11, 2015. Neither source establishes the exact construction start, commissioning day, construction workforce, supplier payments or realized permanent employment.
